summary: Flutter's protected image viewer now exposes a distinct route name and image alternative text derived from the attachment filename. The route semantic container has explicit child nodes so the route label does not absorb the image's alt text. Widget tests inspect the semantic labels. Native screen-reader/focus behavior, live ACL/download, and full DES-09 acceptance remain open.

checks.name: Route accessibility metadata regression test
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/message_attachment_list_test.dart --reporter expanded
checks.observation: With the semantics tree enabled, the test opens a protected image and finds exactly one route node labelled 'Просмотр изображения photo.png'. The explicit semantic container prevents the image alt text from being folded into the route label.

checks.name: Image alternative text regression test
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/message_attachment_list_test.dart --reporter expanded
checks.observation: The same semantics-tree test finds the image node labelled 'photo.png' with image semantics, independently of the route label.

checks.name: Flutter test suite
checks.observation: All 245 widget and unit tests passed.

remaining: Test real screen-reader announcements and focus return on macOS, Windows, and Android; verify protected download ACL and complete the full DES-09 visual, keyboard, loading/error/deleted, zoom, and download acceptance against a live deployment.
